363.text: the Old Nick , with good reason

238.text: this strange country where no men lived -- only women and girl children

55.text: some self - appointed missionaries , or traders , or land - greedy expansionists

quotes.text:
“over there, short river, sweet
water, red and blue.”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
“Just us three. Maybe we can really find
something. May be cinnabar in it.”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
“May be
hundreds of miles from the range. They crop out like that.”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
“Must come from way back in the
hills.”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
“Chemicals of some sort--I can’t tell on the spot. Look to me like
dyestuffs. Let’s get nearer,”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “One day blue--one day red--one day green,”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “They might stay if we told them,”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
“This
is our find. Let’s not tell those cocky old professors. Let’s go on home
with ‘em, and then come back--just us--have a little expedition of our
own.”
quotes.speaker: Unknown
